This is the one step here that changes anything, and it cannot be undone once the network has it. description: Read the Bitcoin blockchain from a workflow, through Blockstream's public Esplora API. Check whether an address has been paid and how deeply the payment is confirmed, list its transactions and the coins it holds, look up any transaction or block, see what fees the network is asking right now, and broadcast a transaction your wallet has already signed. Amounts come back in satoshis and BTC, block times as dates, and confirmations already counted - so a workflow reads a balance rather than four running totals. Works on Bitcoin, testnet and signet. No account or API key required.
